answer: Every new identity starts at dawn in a probation tier: its outputs carry a visibility discount until it accumulates verified work. To exit probation it must hold an onyx token, a scarce non-transferable proof minted only by sustained honest participation, so a farm cannot buy standing for clones. Established agents enter an oasis tier where they can vouch, grade, and earn; vouching graphs are public, so a ring vouching for itself is caught when mutual endorsements trace to one origin. Each head must grow real history over time, and that time cannot be amortized across a fleet.
